children.title: HumanNet (2026) — ~1M h of human-centric video (mix of ego and exo) with interaction-centric annotations; the authors report 1k h of ego human video outperforms 100 h of real-robot data for VLA training. The implementation is public; the repository still lists the preview and full corpus release as pending.

repo_info.description: HumanNet: Scaling Human-centric Video Learning to One Million Hours

children.title: Open-AoE (2026) — ~2,000 h of smartphone-collected manipulation video from 500+ contributors with bilingual text, MANO hand pose, camera trajectory, and atomic-action annotations, plus capture-to-training tools for VLA and world-model research.
EgoVid-5M (2024) — 5M first-person clips curated for text-and-motion-conditioned video generation from wearable footage.

repo_info.description: [Nips 2025] EgoVid-5M: A Large-Scale Video-Action Dataset for Egocentric Video Generation

children.title: [⭐️] Ropedia Xperience-10M (2026) — 10M multimodal experiences with 6 RGB streams, stereo depth, pose/SLAM, hand-body mocap, audio, and IMU for large-scale ego pretraining.

EgoCS-400K (2026) — 400K+ replay-grounded first-person Counter-Strike videos (10K h) aligned with player states, view directions, movements, keyboard/button inputs, events, and round context for action-conditioned rollout, captioning, and world-model training.

Ego-OSCAR-550h (2026) — ~550 h per camera (1,462 stereo sessions) of calibrated everyday egocentric video with synchronized IMU, dense action captions, and 3D hand reconstructions. Capture firmware/software is public; dataset access requires accepting the Hugging Face conditions.

repo_info.description: Open hardware and capture software for the Ego-OSCAR stereo-inertial egocentric camera

children.title: MobileEgo Anywhere (2026) — 200 h of hour-plus egocentric trajectories collected on commodity smartphones, released with an open-source mobile capture app and a processing pipeline aimed at VLA pretraining.

repo_info.description: Python SDK for Stera: Record, Process, Evaluate, and Export Multimodal Data

children.title: WM-H (Wh0) (2026) — 50K world-model-generated egocentric human-object manipulation episodes conditioned on language, objects, and scenes, then converted into robot-trainable supervision for dexterous VLA adaptation.

repo_info.description: Wh0: Generative World Models as Scalable Sources of Egocentric Human Hand Manipulation Data

children.title: WorldRover-10M (2026) — 6,003 synthetic exploration sequences from 32 environments (21.9M frames / 202.7 h, including 10.8M first-person frames) with first-person, third-person, and 360° views aligned to metric depth, trajectories, geometry, and action signals. Public packages include WorldRover-6scenes, WorldRover-styles, and a preview subset; the collection distinguishes their downloadable scope from the full paper corpus.

repo_info.description: A Scalable Synthetic Video Data Engine for World Exploration with Rich Annotations

children.title: AtomEgo (2026) — Curated human egocentric interaction corpus and processing pipeline supporting VLA and world–action model pretraining through co-training, embodiment alignment, and joint video–action modeling. The paper reports approximately 2,659 h. Atom-0 provides the training implementations; a public corpus download remains unverified.

Ego2Act (2026) — Real-world egocentric manipulation benchmark conditioned on an initial scene and a high-level goal, spanning object clutter and multi-step task complexity. Ego2ActJudge evaluates task completion and physical plausibility without reference videos.

repo_info.description: Ego2Act: evaluating goal-directed manipulation in egocentric video generation

children.title: H2R-Bench (2026) — Cross-embodiment benchmark for transforming egocentric human demonstrations into robot manipulation videos, evaluated across six manipulation families, two target embodiments, and five dimensions covering execution, contact, embodiment, and visual quality. The project repository currently contains documentation; evaluation code and benchmark annotations are pending.

children.title: EgoMemReason (2026) — 500 multiple-choice questions over week-long EgoLife video for entity, event, and behavior memory reasoning, with public questions and leaderboard evaluation.

MA-EgoQA (2026) — 1,741 QA pairs over six temporally aligned EgoLife egocentric streams spanning seven days, targeting multi-agent social interaction, task coordination, theory-of-mind, temporal reasoning, and environmental interaction.

repo_info.description: MA-EgoQA: Question Answering over Egocentric Videos from Multiple Embodied Agents

children.title: EgoExoMem (2026) — 2.6K human-verified MCQs over 390 synchronized egocentric and exocentric videos from EgoExo4D and LEMMA for cross-view memory reasoning.

children.title: TempCloze (2026) — Missing-middle video selection with semantic, temporal-alignment, and progression distractors. Primarily long-take and egocentric footage from seven sources; includes third-person material. Public metadata and evaluation code are available; source recordings are obtained separately.

MEMORA-Bench (2026) — 45 h of EPIC-KITCHENS-100 extension video from 18 participants for memory-grounded planning toward seen and unseen goals, plus structured assessment of environment, entity, activity, and inferred-knowledge memory.

APM-Bench (2026) — Related activity sessions form interrupted life trajectories for retrospective questions and proactive responses, evaluating the utility–latency–storage trade-off. Project and repository pages are available; the authors plan the dataset and code release before November 2026.

Ego-SpaCR / SpaC-MEM (2026) — ScanNet-derived video sessions augmented with task-oriented dialogue for cross-scene recall and counterfactual spatial queries. SpaC-MEM supplies reconstruction, memory, and evaluation code plus an Ego-SpaCR v1.0 annotation ZIP with 3,218 questions (3,100 in the official evaluation); ScanNet recordings are obtained separately.

EMBER-Bench (2026) — Newly recorded household tasks with event and causal-chain annotations, covering progress, recovery, external interventions, and distant prerequisites. Paired next-action prediction and causal traceback test how past events constrain current action. Evaluation software is public; the complete dataset release remains pending.

repo_info.description: EMBER-Bench: cross-event causal memory for long-horizon embodied reasoning. Website, leaderboard, and audited evaluation toolkit.

EgoNight (2025) — Real and synthetic first-person videos with aligned day–night subsets and an additional night-only subset; 12 QA types evaluate low-light understanding. Introduced in a 2025 preprint and published at ICLR 2026, with auxiliary depth and day–night retrieval tasks.
